_comment: CANONICAL TELEMETRY BATCH FIXTURE — the payload contract between
crux_telemetry's LiveTelemetryService and the crux-telemetry ingestion
SOURCE OF TRUTH: the ingestion Worker's canonical batch document, whose
acceptance is enforced by the Worker's envelope and event validation.
This file carries the same data. A change to it is a change to both sides
The Worker's own test suite asserts this exact document is accepted;
package's serializer emits it. If those two facts hold, every client in
the suite and the Worker cannot have drifted.
The slug and event names below are WaveCrux's because the Worker's
canonical document is; they are fixture DATA, not vocabulary this package
knows. The product slug arrives from CruxTelemetryConfig, and the event
'_comment' is ignored: unknown top-level fields are dropped by the Worker,
which is itself part of the contract (forward compatibility for clients
older or newer than the deployed Worker).
